original_brief: Show a reusable fabric shopping bag upright with two handles and a few purchased items peeking above the opening. Make the flexible sides and carrying handles clearly distinct from a rigid shopping basket. Preserve the inspected 3dicons dynamic color source. Keep the tall solid body and paired loops visually distinct from the accepted squat slotted shopping basket.
